windows.60: Over the past 60 days, visitors have noted issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly regarding limited menu options and long wait times. Several reviews mentioned that the food quality did not meet expectations, with specific complaints about the preparation and variety of menu items. Wait times for food orders were also a concern, including instances where the kitchen was backed up and orders were delayed without clear communication. While the overall rating remains positive, these operational challenges with food service and wait times should be addressed to improve the visitor experience.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service problems included long wait times and inconsistent availability of menu items, especially later in the day when only grab-and-go options were offered. While some visitors appreciated the library itself, the food and dining experience frequently detracted from their overall visit. Addressing these concerns could improve visitor satisfaction.
